paper_title: DART Distilling Autoregressive Reasoning to Silent Thought
caption: Accuracy and inference time on GSM8K with varying C, the number of ST tokens.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates how GSM8K performance metrics vary with the ST token number \(C\), showing accuracy on a left y-axis and inference time on a right y-axis as \(C\) increases. The x-axis is labeled “ST Token Number \(C\)” and uses a linear scale spanning roughly 0 to 30, with labeled ticks at 0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, and 30. The left y-axis is labeled “Accuracy (%)”, uses a linear scale from 36 to 43 with integer tick marks, and the right y-axis is labeled “Inference time (ms)”, also linear, ranging from 33 to 40 with integer tick marks. The accuracy series is drawn as a solid blue line with circular markers; it starts near 36.8% at \(C=0\), rises to about 39.6% at \(C=1\), increases further to about 42.0% at \(C=6\), dips to around 41.2% at \(C=10\), peaks near 42.6% at \(C=20\), and ends around 42.1% at \(C=30\). The inference-time series is drawn as a solid red line with square markers; it begins around 36.6 ms at \(C=0\), is about 36.5 ms at \(C=1\), increases to roughly 36.7 ms at \(C=6\), returns to about 36.6 ms at \(C=10\), rises to approximately 36.8 ms at \(C=20\), and ends near 36.9 ms at \(C=30\).
